title: 1882. Process Tasks Using Servers

examples.explanation: Events in chronological order go as follows: - At second 0, task 0 is added and processed using server 2 until second 1. - At second 1, server 2 becomes free. Task 1 is added and processed using server 2 until second 3. - At second 2, task 2 is added and processed using server 0 until second 5. - At second 3, server 2 becomes free. Task 3 is added and processed using server 2 until second 5. - At second 4, task 4 is added and processed using server 1 until second 5. - At second 5, all servers become free. Task 5 is added and processed using server 2 until second 7.

Events in chronological order go as follows: - At second 0, task 0 is added and processed using server 1 until second 2. - At second 1, task 1 is added and processed using server 4 until second 2. - At second 2, servers 1 and 4 become free. Task 2 is added and processed using server 1 until second 4. - At second 3, task 3 is added and processed using server 4 until second 7. - At second 4, server 1 becomes free. Task 4 is added and processed using server 1 until second 9. - At second 5, task 5 is added and processed using server 3 until second 7. - At second 6, task 6 is added and processed using server 2 until second 7.
